主要内容: On February 18, 2014, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. filed an 8-K form with the SEC, disclosing that it is providing investor presentation slides as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report. These slides may be used in conversations with investors and analysts and will also be posted on the investor relations section of the company's website. The information provided in this filing is not deemed "filed" under Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other filing under the Securities Act of 1933, unless specifically referenced. The presentation is part of the company's ongoing communication with stakeholders.
